description: Predictor audit for Dataset A Part 2. Covers Written Premium (WP), Loss Ratio (LR), and Retention Ratio (RR) forward-looking models.

modeling_decisions.specification: Specification A (forward-looking): uses only lagged and contemporaneously-safe predictors
modeling_decisions.excluded_years_reason: Partial reporting years confirmed by data completeness review
modeling_decisions.model_condition: Forward-looking Written Premium models are conditioned on active premium-producing observations (PROD_ABBR != 'COMMPOL', WRTN_PREM_AMT > 0).
modeling_decisions.poly_inforce_decision: POLY_INFORCE_QTY is excluded from forward-looking WP models because it is jointly determined with WRTN_PREM_AMT in the same reporting period. PREV_POLY_INFORCE_QTY (lagged) is used instead. No secondary explanatory model is built for this relationship in Dataset A Part 2.

variables.name: AGENCY_ID
variables.description: Agency identifier — used as grouping factor in LMM random effects, not a fixed-effect predictor
variables.recommendation: Use as random effect grouping factor only: (1 | AGENCY_ID)

variables.name: PRIMARY_AGENCY_ID
variables.description: Parent agency identifier — used as grouping factor in nested LMM, not a fixed-effect predictor
variables.recommendation: Use as random effect grouping factor only: (1 | PRIMARY_AGENCY_ID / AGENCY_ID)

variables.name: WRTN_PREM_AMT
variables.description: Written premium — the primary modeling target. Modeled as log(WRTN_PREM_AMT + 1). Rows with WP <= 0 or COMMPOL excluded.
variables.leakage_concern: If used as a predictor for LR: WRTN_PREM_AMT is correlated with the LR denominator. Use with caution.
variables.recommendation: Primary target for WP modeling. Not a predictor.

variables.name: STAT_PROFILE_DATE_YEAR
variables.description: Reporting year (2005-2015) — captures temporal trend and macroeconomic context

variables.name: STATE_ABBR
variables.description: State of agency operation — captures geographic and regulatory pricing environment
variables.recommendation: Include in all models as categorical factor

variables.name: PROD_LINE
variables.description: Product line (CL = Commercial Lines, PL = Personal Lines) — major business segment indicator
variables.recommendation: Include in all models as categorical factor

variables.name: PROD_ABBR
variables.description: Product abbreviation — specific product code within product line. Note: exclude COMMPOL rows before modeling.

variables.name: VENDOR
variables.description: Agency management system vendor — proxy for agency technology and workflow maturity
variables.recommendation: Include in all models as categorical factor

variables.name: VENDOR_IND
variables.description: Vendor indicator flag (Y/N) — binary version of vendor affiliation
variables.recommendation: Potentially redundant with VENDOR; include one or check VIF

variables.name: ACTIVE_PRODUCERS
variables.description: Number of active producers at the agency — direct measure of sales capacity

variables.name: PREV_WRTN_PREM_AMT
variables.description: Prior-year written premium — clean lag; strongest single predictor of current-year premium
variables.recommendation: Include in all models; apply log(x + 1) transform for WP modeling

variables.name: PREV_POLY_INFORCE_QTY
variables.description: Prior-year policies in force — clean lag; preferred policy-count predictor for forward-looking WP model
variables.recommendation: Include in all models; replaces contemporaneous POLY_INFORCE_QTY in forward-looking WP specification

variables.name: MONTHS
variables.description: Number of months in the reporting period — partial-year indicator (8 or 12); needed for period normalization
variables.recommendation: Include; 2005 and 2015 exclusion removes most partial-year rows

variables.name: AGENCY_APPOINTMENT_YEAR
variables.description: Year agency was appointed — proxy for tenure and experience. Check for sentinel values.
variables.recommendation: Include directly or derive TENURE = STAT_PROFILE_DATE_YEAR - AGENCY_APPOINTMENT_YEAR in feature engineering phase

variables.name: MAX_AGE
variables.description: Maximum producer age at agency — proxy for producer experience profile

variables.name: MIN_AGE
variables.description: Minimum producer age at agency — proxy for producer youth or new entrants

variables.name: PL_START_YEAR
variables.description: Personal lines appointment start year. Sentinel 99999 = no PL appointment (CL-only agency).

variables.name: PL_END_YEAR
variables.description: Personal lines appointment end year. Sentinel 99999 = ongoing or not applicable.
variables.recommendation: Replace sentinels with NA before use

variables.name: CL_START_YEAR
variables.description: Commercial lines appointment start year. Sentinel 99999 = no CL appointment.
variables.recommendation: Replace sentinels with NA before use

variables.name: CL_END_YEAR
variables.description: Commercial lines appointment end year.
variables.recommendation: Replace sentinels with NA before use

variables.name: COMMISIONS_START_YEAR
variables.description: Commission arrangement start year.
variables.recommendation: Replace sentinels with NA before use

variables.name: COMMISIONS_END_YEAR
variables.description: Commission arrangement end year.
variables.recommendation: Replace sentinels with NA before use

variables.name: ACTIVITY_NOTES_START_YEAR
variables.description: Activity notes record start year.
variables.recommendation: Replace sentinels with NA before use

variables.name: ACTIVITY_NOTES_END_YEAR
variables.description: Activity notes record end year.
variables.recommendation: Replace sentinels with NA before use

variables.name: POLY_INFORCE_QTY
variables.description: Current-year policies in force — contemporaneous with WRTN_PREM_AMT; jointly determined in the same reporting period
variables.leakage_concern: POLY_INFORCE_QTY and WRTN_PREM_AMT are both outcomes of the same period's policy-writing activity. Including POLY_INFORCE_QTY in a forward-looking WP model conflates a contemporaneous outcome with a predictor. PREV_POLY_INFORCE_QTY (the lagged version) is used instead.
variables.recommendation: Exclude from WP forward-looking model. Use PREV_POLY_INFORCE_QTY.

variables.name: RETENTION_RATIO
variables.description: Retention ratio (raw column) — current-period policy retention outcome; sentinel-contaminated (99997/99998/99999)
variables.leakage_concern: Current-period retention rate is a contemporaneous outcome in the same period as WP. Raw column also contains sentinel values requiring exclusion.
variables.recommendation: Exclude from WP forward-looking model. If used for RR modeling: exclude sentinels first.

variables.name: RETENTION_POLY_QTY
variables.description: Retained policy count — current-period retention outcome, contemporaneous with WP
variables.leakage_concern: Current-period policy retention count; jointly determined with WP in the same period.

variables.name: NB_WRTN_PREM_AMT
variables.description: New business written premium — a direct sub-component of WRTN_PREM_AMT (WP = new business + renewals)
variables.leakage_concern: NB_WRTN_PREM_AMT is a component of WRTN_PREM_AMT. Including it as a predictor would inflate R^2 without adding predictive insight and constitutes near-perfect leakage.

variables.name: PRD_ERND_PREM_AMT
variables.description: Earned premium — contemporaneous current-year earned premium derived from written premium over the policy period
variables.leakage_concern: Contemporaneous with WRTN_PREM_AMT; derived from it over the policy period. For LR modeling: PRD_ERND_PREM_AMT is the denominator of the loss ratio target.
variables.recommendation: Exclude from WP and LR forward-looking models

variables.name: PRD_INCRD_LOSSES_AMT
variables.description: Incurred losses — current-year loss outcome; used for portfolio-level loss ratio reporting and diagnostic investigation only
variables.leakage_concern: Current-year loss outcome. Contemporaneous with any current-year target; excluded from forward-looking models.
variables.recommendation: Exclude from WP and LR forward-looking models

variables.name: LOSS_RATIO
variables.description: Dataset-provided row-level loss ratio field; sentinel-contaminated (99997/99998/99999)
variables.leakage_concern: Derived from current-year incurred losses and earned premium — contemporaneous with any current-year target. Contains sentinel values (99997/99998/99999) requiring handling before use. For row-level LR modeling: this field is the preferred candidate target after sentinel cleaning, not a recomputed ratio.
variables.recommendation: Exclude from WP model. For LR modeling: preferred candidate target after sentinel handling.

variables.name: LOSS_RATIO_3YR
variables.description: 3-year rolling average loss ratio — rolling window includes current-year losses; sentinel-contaminated
variables.leakage_concern: Rolling window includes current-year loss outcomes; leakage for any current-year target.
variables.recommendation: Exclude from WP and LR forward-looking models

variables.name: GROWTH_RATE_3YR
variables.description: 3-year rolling growth rate — rolling window includes current-year written premium
variables.leakage_concern: Rolling window includes current-year WRTN_PREM_AMT; leakage for WP model.
